content:
是时候唤醒你的大脑，开始**创造**了！建造**火车**、自动化**农场**、驾驶**飞机**以及更多**精彩内容**！

# 这是什么？
添加了**[Create Fabric](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-fabric)**、其最佳附属模组以及更多提升游戏体验的模组。

# 社交平台：
[Discord服务器](https://discord.gg/2XzK42Dr5J)\
[Twitter / X](https://x.com/Jonkl7937)

### Create附属模组：
[Create: Steam 'n' Rails](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-steam-n-rails)、[Create Deco](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-deco)、[Create: Armor Trims](https://modrinth.com/datapack/create-mod-trims/version/2.0.1)、[Create: Copycats+](https://modrinth.com/mod/copycats)、[Create Slice & Dice](https://modrinth.com/mod/slice-and-dice)、[Create Man of Many Planes](https://modrinth.com/datapack/create-man-of-many-planes)（[+Immersive Aircraft](https://modrinth.com/mod/immersive-aircraft)、[+Man Of Many Planes](https://modrinth.com/mod/man-of-many-planes)）、[Create: Interiors](https://modrinth.com/mod/interiors)、[Create: High Pressure](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-high-pressure)、[Create Goggles](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-goggles)、[Netherracked](https://modrinth.com/datapack/netherracked)、[Create Jetpack](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-jetpack)和[Create Railways Navigator](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-railways-navigator)、[Create: Dreams & Desires](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-dreams-and-desires)、[Create Contraption Terminals](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-contraption-terminals)、[Create Enchantment Industry Fabric](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-enchantment-industry-fabric)和[Create: Numismatics](https://modrinth.com/mod/numismatics)、[Create: Copper & Zinc](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-copper-zinc)！

### 其他模组：
[Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium)、[Iris Shaders](https://modrinth.com/mod/iris)、[JEI](https://modrinth.com/mod/jei)、[Inventorio](https://modrinth.com/mod/inventorio)、[Zoomify](https://modrinth.com/mod/zoomify)、[Indium](https://modrinth.com/mod/indium)、[Macaw's Furniture](https://modrinth.com/mod/macaws-furniture)、[Xaero的世界地图](https://modrinth.com/mod/xaeros-world-map)+[小地图](https://modrinth.com/mod/xaeros-minimap)、[Chisel Reborn](https://modrinth.com/mod/chisel-reborn)、[ReplayMod](https://modrinth.com/mod/replaymod)、[Jade🔍](https://modrinth.com/mod/jade)、[Jade附属（Fabric版）](https://modrinth.com/mod/jade-addons-fabric)、[Simple Voice Chat](https://modrinth.com/plugin/simple-voice-chat)、[AppleSkin](https://modrinth.com/mod/appleskin)、[Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu)、[Tom's Simple Storage Mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/toms-storage)、[Sodium Extra](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium-extra)、[No Chat Reports](https://modrinth.com/mod/no-chat-reports)、[Borderless Mining](https://modrinth.com/mod/borderless-mining)、[DnT](https://modrinth.com/datapack/dungeons-and-taverns)、[Terralith](https://modrinth.com/datapack/terralith)、[Tectonic](https://modrinth.com/datapack/tectonic)、以及所有必需的API和库、优化模组。（请阅读**更新日志**了解所有**新增/移除**的模组）

### 光影包：
[Complementary Shaders - Reimagined](https://modrinth.com/shader/complementary-reimagined)、
[Complementary Shaders - Unbound](https://modrinth.com/shader/complementary-unbound)、
[MakeUp - Ultra Fast](https://modrinth.com/shader/makeup-ultra-fast-shaders)、
[Rethinking Voxels](https://modrinth.com/shader/rethinking-voxels)、[BSL](https://modrinth.com/shader/bsl-shaders)

### 遗留模组：
[Create: Power Loader (Fabric)](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-power-loader-fabric)、[Whitelistd](https://modrinth.com/mod/whitelistd)

### 资源包：
[Better Visible Ores](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/better-visible-ores)


# 支持版本：
**Fabric 1.20.1**\
[(**Forge 1.20.1**)](https://modrinth.com/modpack/create+neoforge)

# 问题反馈：
请将错误和问题报告至[Discord服务器](https://discord.gg/2XzK42Dr5J)或[问题追踪器](https://github.com/Not-Awake-Studios/Create/issues)。
如有疑问，欢迎加入[Discord](https://discord.gg/2XzK42Dr5J)。


<details>
<summary>常见问题</summary>

问：我**无法生成超平坦**世界。\
答：请在Modrinth应用中**禁用Terralith**。

问：如何在服务器上设置这个整合包？\
答：虽然整合包不能直接在服务器上运行，但[Discord](https://discord.gg/2XzK42Dr5J)上有一个包含所有服务端模组的压缩包。

</details>



# 启动器：
你需要使用Modrinth应用来安装此整合包。暂不计划支持CurseForge。

### 由[**Not Awake Studios**](https://modrinth.com/organization/NotAwakeStudios)制作。
